prompt: In CLM, business users should ask Legal for a contract through a form inside CLM: request type, agreement type, our contracting entity and business unit, the counterparty, estimated value, target date, and their draft when it is on the counterparty's paper. Counterparty, entity and business unit must be searchable in CLM. Each submission should start a CLM workflow that sends the request to Legal.

features: attribute fields for counterparty, entity and business unit
custom answers for request type, agreement type, value and target date
attachment shown only when the paper is theirs, required then
Email Document to Legal with the answers merged

acceptance: counterparty, entity and business unit are attribute fields; the other answers are custom ids in camelCase
the draft upload shows only when the paper is theirs and Save is blocked without it then
the eForm's Set Workflow names the CLM workflow, which is published first
the workflow reads the custom answers at Params CustomFormFields
hard_parts: attribute field ids are the account's: Generate Sample Form, or the account values
every Save of the eForm turns off Allow Submission
a show-if rule does not run in the designer Preview

clarifying_questions.question: Which answers must be searchable or route the workflow (attributes), and which are form-only?
clarifying_questions.default: party, entity, business unit and the third-party flag are attributes; request type, agreement type, value and dates are form answers
